thread:
maria: quick flag — noticed sampled telemetry for /generate returns raw user prompt in log when inspect-mode + per-route override enabled. repro: set route sampling 100% then enable inspect-mode for team, logs show request.body in raw.
kevin: whoa that's bad, can you paste minimal config?
maria: here — ```yaml
routes:
  - id: chat
    sampling:
      type: per_route
      rate: 1.0
inspect_mode: enabled
```
sam: is inspect-mode supposed to redact by default? last we discussed it's opt-in and should scrub PII unless breakglass
maria: it scrubs by default but per-route override bypassed the scrub step due to ordering bug. looks like sampler runs after scrub in main pipeline, but per-route path short-circuits and emits pre-scrub event.
kevin: ok reproduce steps and severity? ops-bot: incident-checklist: create ticket if PII could be leaked to SRE.
maria: low volume in canary but still fail. I'd mark P2 and rollback per-route override to safe default.
sam: UX question — console shows "inspect enabled" with a link to override. We should change wording to "inspect (PII redaction applied)" when safe and add warning when per-route override active.
kevin: agree. short-term: revert per-route override rollout and patch ordering so scrub runs before emitter. long-term: audit pipeline ordering + add automated tests.
maria: I'll open PR for ordering patch and rollback playbook. tagging @kevin for rollback approval.
kevin: approve. pls include QA steps: 1) enable inspect-mode 2) hit canary route 3) check telemetry stream for raw prompt
sam: also add console banner: "Inspect overrides may expose raw content to ops. Use only with approval." :warning: 
devex-bot: created ticket INF-1298 with priority P2 assigned to eng-platform
maria: thanks — will update thread with PR and rollback timestamp
